title: Georgia consumable-hemp retail
description: Narrows the jurisdiction-neutral core schema to what a Georgia consumable-hemp retailer may lawfully sell: excludes flower/preroll retail sale, applies per-product_form THC mg caps, enforces the total-THC ≤0.3% dry-weight formula, and requires a linked, in-date, publicly reachable, passing Certificate of Analysis (COA) before a Package is profile-valid. Composition is allOf-only over core — this profile restricts, never extends (decision-hemp-interchange-schema-scope). Not legal advice; encoded strictly from the cited primary sources below, per research-synthesis-ga-hemp-rule-read-and-d8449. See rules/README.md for rule IDs and NOT_MODELED.md for what this profile deliberately does not enforce.
